description: This file implements functions for parsing, validating, and applying refspecs in a Git-like version control system. It defines structures and methods to handle refspec parsing, matching, inclusion, exclusion, and transformations between source and destination references.

classes.name: refspec_item
classes.description: Structure representing a single refspec item with source, destination, flags, and raw input.

classes.name: refspec
classes.description: Structure representing a collection of refspec items with fetch/populate flags.

methods.name: int parse_refspec(struct refspec_item * item,const char * refspec,int fetch)
methods.description: Parses a refspec string into a refspec_item, validating its format and semantics.

methods.name: int refspec_item_init(struct refspec_item * item,const char * refspec,int fetch)
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item and parses the refspec string.

methods.name: int refspec_item_init_fetch(struct refspec_item * item,const char * refspec)
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item for fetch operation.

methods.name: int refspec_item_init_push(struct refspec_item * item,const char * refspec)
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item for push operation.

methods.name: void refspec_item_clear(struct refspec_item * item)
methods.description: Clears memory allocated within a refspec_item.

methods.name: void refspec_init_fetch(struct refspec * rs)
methods.description: Initializes a refspec for fetch operations with default values.

methods.name: void refspec_init_push(struct refspec * rs)
methods.description: Initializes a refspec for push operations with default values.

methods.name: void refspec_append(struct refspec * rs,const char * refspec)
methods.description: Appends a new refspec string to a refspec collection, parsing and validating it.

methods.name: void refspec_appendf(struct refspec * rs,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Appends a formatted refspec string to a refspec collection.

methods.name: void refspec_appendn(struct refspec * rs,const char ** refspecs,int nr)
methods.description: Appends multiple refspec strings to a refspec collection.

methods.name: void refspec_clear(struct refspec * rs)
methods.description: Clears and resets a refspec collection.

methods.name: int valid_fetch_refspec(const char * fetch_refspec_str)
methods.description: Checks whether a fetch refspec string is valid.

methods.name: void refspec_ref_prefixes(const struct refspec * rs,struct strvec * ref_prefixes)
methods.description: Extracts reference prefixes from a refspec collection.

methods.name: int match_refname_with_pattern(const char * pattern,const char * refname,const char * replacement,char ** result)
methods.description: Checks if a refname matches a glob pattern and constructs a replacement if provided.

methods.name: int refspec_match(const struct refspec_item * refspec,const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if a refspec matches a given refname.

methods.name: int refname_matches_negative_refspec_item(const char * refname,struct refspec * rs)
methods.description: Determines if a refname matches any negative refspecs.

methods.name: int refspec_find_negative_match(struct refspec * rs,struct refspec_item * query)
methods.description: Checks whether a refspec matches any negative refspecs for a query.

methods.name: void refspec_find_all_matches(struct refspec * rs,struct refspec_item * query,struct string_list * results)
methods.description: Finds all refs matching a query in refspecs and populates the results list.

methods.name: int refspec_find_match(struct refspec * rs,struct refspec_item * query)
methods.description: Finds a single matching ref in refspecs for a query.

methods.name: struct:ref * apply_negative_refspecs(struct ref * ref_map,struct refspec * rs)
methods.description: Removes refs that match negative refspecs from a ref list.

methods.name: char * apply_refspecs(struct refspec * rs,const char * name)
methods.description: Applies refspec transformations to a reference name.

ctags.name: match_refname_with_pattern
ctags.signature: (const char * pattern,const char * refname,const char * replacement,char ** result)

ctags.name: parse_refspec
ctags.pattern: /^static int parse_refspec(struct refspec_item *item, const char *refspec, int fetch)$/

ctags.name: refspec_appendn
ctags.pattern: /^void refspec_appendn(struct refspec *rs, const char **refspecs, int nr)$/

ctags.name: refspec_find_all_matches
ctags.signature: (struct refspec * rs,struct refspec_item * query,struct string_list * results)
